The project is located in a gang-controlled neighbourhood in Port-au-Prince. It offers children who would otherwise have no opportunity to receive basic education (grades 1-9) the chance to go to school. Most of these children have been given to acquaintances by their parents to work as domestic helpers, with the prospect of also being able to attend school, which the host families often do not allow.
